summary: @servicetitan/react-hooks preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub releases URL into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and immediately execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (WV8StW string-array rotator, n7gIxM encoded-literal table, hc1jfK9 alphabet decoder, randomized hex identifiers, '// @bun @bun-cjs' header) that only executes under the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection of the install-time code path. The tarball's dist/ tree ships real-looking React hook TypeScript sources as cover; the declared repository github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib has no requirement for Bun or for a 727KB math bundle at install. On npm install of this version, the obfuscated bundle executes on the installer's host under an alternate runtime the package silently provisions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
